name: GLM 4.6V Flash
short: Z.ai's 9B multimodal vision-language model with 128K context, native visual function calling, and fast local edge inference.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
pricingNote: Free on Zen; open weights under Apache 2.0 / open license
standout: 9B edge-deployable vision-language model featuring native function calling with visual inputs and full 128K context.
tradeoff: 9B parameter capacity trades away deep multi-step textual reasoning compared to 30B+ MoE and dense frontier models.
